neighbours.label: the final piece of an uncommon name or compound noun (Rod|ale, help|_text, loan shark, training aircraft)
fire: The magazine was owned by the publisher Rodale for years.
Set the help_text argument on each form field.
He borrowed cash from a loan shark in the casino.
Old training aircraft were sold to private collectors.
The image's alt_text label was missing.
The country retired its fleet of cargo aircraft.
Rodale also runs an organic farm in Pennsylvania.
Gamblers often fall into the hands of a loan shark.
quiet: The magazine was owned by a big publisher for years.
Set the label argument on each form field.
He borrowed cash from a friend in the casino.
Old training manuals were sold to private collectors.
The country retired its fleet of cargo ships.
The company also runs an organic farm in Pennsylvania.
Gamblers often fall into debt quickly.

notes: Probes: Rodale 1.10, training aircraft 0.69, loan shark 0.54, help_text 0.44; ordinary compounds (fire truck, flight attendant) ~0.02, so this is a list more than a pattern.
